reason: I like the idea of customers coming to me and the money being held until the job is done, but I do not want to upload my ID and commercial registration and then wait for someone to approve me before I can even quote. I have enough paperwork already and I would rather keep working the way I do now.
objection: I would have to hand over documents and wait for a reviewer before I could send a single quote, and I still would not know if the customers are real or if they will change their mind after I have booked the slot.
would_change_my_mind: Being able to quote and see the requests straight away without uploading documents or waiting for approval, with the first customers already in the inbox.
